Changelog

A record of new tools, formula calibrations, data updates and site-structure changes. Verification results are added here as the game updates.

October 7, 2026

  • The site is now run as a non-commercial fan site without ads: all ad slots, ad code and affiliate links have been removed, and the advertising section of the Privacy Policy was rewritten.
  • Changed how the generation stats are collected. Previously only builds sent through the submission form were counted; now what you calculate in the Bear Hunt Simulator is aggregated automatically and anonymously (you can stop and delete it anytime with "Opt out" in the result panel). Reviews are still posted through the form.
  • Generation pages now show the most-used joiner heroes and a score scale (distribution of estimated damage) for that generation. The simulator's result panel also shows your own score within your generation (once a generation has 10 records).
  • Damage used for the stats is recomputed with the correction factor C (standard 0.63) and the advanced coefficients set to the same values for everyone, so scores compare like with like even if you changed C on screen.
  • The simulator's result panel now shows a distribution chart of damage per rally: how likely each range is depending on how often chance skills trigger (unlucky / typical / lucky). The score also comes with a small chart of your position within your generation.
  • Inputs that cannot occur in the actual game (attack above 3000%, all eight stats identical, extreme troop counts, etc.) are excluded. The rules are listed under Methodology, and the Privacy Policy has been updated.

October 5, 2026

  • The Bear Hunt Simulator now counts "enemy DEF -25%" (Hendrik, Ligeia, Estrella, Eleanor, and Ursar's periodic version) as x1.25 instead of about x1.14, following a player report that one DEF-down joiner beats stacking another attack joiner.
  • Fixed a data error: six heroes whose exclusive gear gives "Rally Troops' Attack / Lethality +15%" (Gwen, Renee, Gordon, Hendrik, Blanchette, Rufus) were missing that bonus in the calculation. Their rally-leader damage now rises with gear level.
  • Recomputed the theoretical rankings on the generation pages with revised assumptions: (1) joiners are no longer fixed, each line-up is compared with its best four; (2) base stats excluding heroes were raised to realistic values (newer-generation heroes were favoured more than they should be). See the methodology page.
  • The Left-Hero Checker now uses the same bucket definitions as the simulator ("enemy DEF-down" and "enemy DMG-taken" are their own buckets), and the left-hero and rally leader guides explain DEF-down.

October 1, 2026

  • Added Generation 17: Aiden (infantry, Lucky Wheel), Bertha (lancer, events) and Eleanor (marksman, Hall of Heroes). Their leader skills are modelled from the official wiki's expedition skills and added to the simulator, Left-Hero Checker, Hero Database (65 heroes) and the generation pages (Gen 1–17). Bertha's follow-ups use the same calibration as existing heroes (halved, same-type counted once) so the ranking stays consistent with strategy-site picks (Mia/Dominic for lancer, Eleanor for marksman). Gen 17's unlock day (server day 1,240) is extrapolated from the 80-day cadence.
  • The build now strips the English text from Japanese pages and the Japanese text from English pages (no visible change). English pages also get static English titles, descriptions, headings and structured data, and the generation pages are now written out in English rather than translated in the browser. Pages are lighter and search engines see one language per page.
  • Re-applied the fixes for English-page links jumping to the Japanese site and for the non-existent URLs Search Console picked up from JS strings.

September 14, 2026

  • Redesigned the home page: dark hero (headline, main CTAs, site stats), cards for the three featured tools and the other tools, a generation-builds band, three guide-category cards and an operator card, with Material Symbols replacing emoji.
  • Reorganised the header navigation into four top-level categories (Tools / Gen Builds / Guides / About) that open into sub-categories and pages — a dropdown on desktop and an accordion behind the menu button on phones — so every page (9 tools, 16 generation pages, 12 guides, about/contact etc.) is reachable from the header. Keyboard friendly (Tab / Enter / Esc).
  • The footer now mirrors the same four categories as a site map. Header, footer and section icons now use Google's Material Symbols (Apache-2.0), with the menus redesigned as dark panels.
  • Added an "About this tool" block (what it tells you / how it works / how to use it) at the top of every tool page, in both languages.
  • Added creator, publish date, last-updated date and verification environment to every tool page; generation pages now show their first-published date too.
  • Fixed the English Hero Database page showing Japanese, an untranslated heading in the Troop Ratio Simulator, and links on English pages (e.g. generation pages → simulator) that jumped to the Japanese site; English pages now stay within /en/.

September 4, 2026

  • Re-modelled Hector's leader skill "Thunder Charge" from the official wiki (inf dmg +200% / mks dmg +100%, decaying to 85% per attack over 10 attacks) and calibrated it to the community ranking (Jeronimo > Hector > Natalia). The infantry rankings on the generation pages and the "Rally leader: recommended formations" guide now agree; the guide's lancer order was updated to match the theoretical rankings as well.

September 3, 2026

  • Reworked the generation pages into "Bear Hunt best heroes & builds by generation". Each page now opens with a summary and an "Ideal build" block: pick your spending tier and the best three rally-leader heroes are shown large, with a one-tap button that sets them in the Bear Hunt Simulator. Added FAQs and structured data.
  • The simulator's STEP 1 now links to the recommended-build page for the selected generation, and the stats submission form is pre-filled with the predicted damage.
  • Added a "Reviews" block to each generation page. The submission form now has an optional one-liner (200 chars) and display name, shown with the build newest first; links and abusive wording are rejected, and 3 reports hide a review automatically for operator review. The "Whale" tier is now explicitly computed with everything maxed (gear Lv10, FC Lv10, T12).

September 2, 2026

  • Launched Generation stats: rally-leader Bear Hunt builds (INF/LAN/MKS) aggregated per generation from user submissions, shown alongside theoretical best builds per spending tier. Added a submission page and one-click submission from the simulator.
  • Extracted the simulator's calculation core into a shared module (bear-calc.js). Results are unchanged (2,113-case regression test).
  • Unified the hero master (heroes.js) to the latest skill data. Left-Hero Checker now marks heroes with no Bear Hunt effect (Renee, Gordon).
  • Removed the OFUSE support links from all pages.
  • Privacy policy and terms updated for submitted statistics.

July 24, 2026

  • Published the guide "Cyrille deep-dive: every skill & upgrade priority" — full stats from the official wiki plus community opinions from X.
  • Added a "Sources & references" panel to every guide (official / strategy-site / community / our research, labeled), plus collapsible third-party verification data on key guides.
  • Embedded official beginner-guide videos from the official YouTube channel (via YouTube's official embed feature, with source and copyright attribution) on the home page, beginner FAQ and Bear Hunt guide, and the official expert-system X post on the Cyrille guide.
  • Split Japanese and English into separate URLs (Japanese = /, English = /en/); added hreflang and self-referencing canonical to every page.
  • Strengthened the Advertising section of the Privacy Policy to cover third-party vendors, cookies and opt-out.
  • Reworked the operator page to state verification experience, editorial policy, how numbers are checked and the correction policy. Moved alliance recruitment to its own page.
  • Added explanations (how to use, input meanings, reading results, cautions) to every tool page.
  • Added author / publish date / last updated / verification environment to every guide.
  • Added this changelog page.

July 4, 2026

  • Released the "Frost Dragon Placement Calculator".

June 26, 2026

  • Released the "Foundry Battle field tool".
  • Released the "Hero Database" (all 62 heroes).

June 19, 2026

  • Released the "Castle Battle Area Planner".

June 16, 2026

  • Site launched with the "Bear Hunt Damage Simulator" and the initial tools and guides.
